value.rationale: The regular nine-vertex torus is a canonical highly symmetric triangulation. The complete minimum simple-cycle layer is therefore a natural combinatorial systolic invariant. The theorem does more than recompute \(H_1\): it shows that all nine empty triangles are primitive systoles, resolves their exact three-by-three lattice-direction spectrum, and identifies the order-\(9\) homology-kernel orbits and order-\(12\) quotient symmetry controlling that spectrum.
